name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.210: The allowance gate now works like the download switch, at the switch's own two
    places, and the check moved out of the seeder. The seeder fills queues and does not decide
    policy: it takes a plain flag beside DownloadEnabled and asks the API nothing. The dispatcher
    probes once per cycle before the download seed - only when the cycle covers the download
    direction - and a spent download OR search allowance then holds the queue back AND stops the
    run, exactly as switching the direction off does. A read that fails is not a verdict.
